race.comment: DUN DARTE CHEAP (2) comes off a decisive Mdn win at the Gold Coast Poly. Showed enough early dash last time to suggest he can offset the wide draw here and give them something to catch. Gets his chance to make it two on the trot. BRASS BAND (3) struggled last time but was a good winner at Grafton the start prior. Drops sharply in trip for this but does shoulder form that keeps him in contention. I AM PIETRA (14) has been around the mark, draws well and gets weight relief after her Eidsvold second, but this is harder company than picnic grade and her 1400m record leaves some reservation. HAWAIIAN BLOOM (12) has been mixing her form but has shown glimpses of ability. McColm's claim gets her in light and she's worth keeping safe.
